sources.title: 정부, 저가 공세 중국산 봉강에 '칼 빼들었다'
evidence: 재정경제부는 지난 11월 13일 '중국산 봉강에 대한 잠정덤핑방지관세 부과 제정안'을 행정예고하고, 오는 12월 1일부터 내년 3월 31일까지 4개월간 잠정덤핑방지관세를 부과한다고 밝혔다.
각 업체별 잠정덤핑방지관세율은 장수 용강(Jiangsu Yonggang Group Co., Ltd.) 및 그 관계사가 25.08%,
다예(Daye Special Steel Co., Ltd.) 및 그 관계사가 27.96%, 그 밖의 공급자 27.33%이다.
철근, 형강, 중공(中空) 드릴봉 등은 조사 대상에서 제외한다.
이 제정안에 대해 의견이 있는 기관·단체 또는 개인은 오는 11월 23일까지 재정경제부에 의견서를 제출할 수 있다.
이에 오는 12월 17일 무역위원회가 개최 예정인 '중국산 봉강 국내 산업피해 조사 공청회'와 내년도 반덤핑 최종판정 이전까지 특수강봉강 업계와 중소 부품업계의 치열한 공방이 지속될 것으로 보인다.

sources.title: Capstone cuts copper outlook as restart slips
evidence: Capstone Copper (TSX: CS; ASX: CSC) has lowered the bottom of its annual copper production forecast by 5,000 tonnes
after delaying the full restart of its Pinto Valley operation in Arizona until mid-December.
The primary crusher needs additional repairs to major mechanical components being manufactured off-site
Mobile crushers should allow partial processing to resume in mid-November.
The revised production floor is 195,000 tonnes.
Capstone estimated the additional downtime would reduce this year’s copper output by about 5,000 tonnes
Pinto Valley produced 6,358 tonnes of copper in the third quarter, compared with 9,949 tonnes a year earlier.

sources.title: Exclusive-Iraq turns to trucks to export oil in overland Syrian route revival
evidence: since the Strait of Hormuz, its usual outlet, was disrupted by the Iran war.
Since last month, Qatari energy group UCC Holding has been shipping Iraqi crude oil by truck to Baniyas
UCC began shipping 120,000 to 150,000 barrels per day (bpd) under a contract with state oil marketer SOMO
UCC already has a fleet of 6,000 trucks which it is expanding to 10,000 for the route
Since the deal took effect on October 26, UCC has loaded about 1.6 million barrels
The oil is loaded onto ships in Baniyas for delivery to Mediterranean refineries in Greece, Italy and Turkey
Iraq produced nearly 4.5 million bpd in October, about half a million barrels more than a month earlier
